title: GitHub to Disable npm Install Scripts by Default to Stop Supply Chain Attacks
summary: GitHub has announced what it said are "breaking changes" coming to npm version 12, one of which turns off install scripts by default to combat software supply chain threats.

title: Nottingham University data breach affects over 450,000 students

title: Max severity Ivanti Sentry vulnerability now exploited in attacks

title: Chinese, N. Korean Threat Groups Build on Asia-Pacific Success
summary: North Korea's gross domestic product (GDP) has grown, in part because of the cybercrime gains of groups linked to the nation, which target business and financial firms.
